row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (per-user licences plus a platform fee)
row.evidence: Gong's help centre marks team member provisioning, including its generic SCIM endpoint (provisioning.gong.io), as "Available on: Any Gong plan"; the pricing page gives no tiers, only per-user licences plus a platform fee.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to free: the June row said SCIM is Enterprise-only and requires SAML SSO, and gave Foundation ~$108-119/u/mo and a $5K-$50K platform fee; none of that is on a current first-party page and it is dropped. Gong's pricing page lists no plans or prices (quote-based: 'Licenses are priced per user' plus 'a platform fee based on the number of users supported'). Every provisioning and SAML SSO help article says 'Available on: Any Gong plan', so there is no SCIM upcharge. Provisioning sources: Okta (OIN app, SAML + SCIM), Entra ID (gallery app), OneLogin, Rippling, Salesforce, and a custom SCIM 2.0 source authenticated with an OAuth bearer token. Deprovisioning deactivates the user (cannot sign in, data capture off). Gong's public API is read-only for users (list/get users, permission profiles) plus an audit logs endpoint; rate limit 3 calls/second and 10,000/day.

plans.name: Gong (quote-based)
plans.price_text: Licenses are priced per user; platform fee based on the number of users supported
plans.notes: No named tiers on the pricing page; SCIM, SAML SSO and the API are documented as available on any Gong plan.

auth.token_source: Admin center > Settings > People > Team Member Provisioning > Custom source; OAuth bearer token acquired through the standard Gong app OAuth flow (Okta uses 'Authenticate with Gong').

operations.notes: Documented: POST /Users, PUT /Users/{id} (update and active=false), POST /Groups, PATCH /Groups/{id} (add/remove members), DELETE /Groups/{id}. User DELETE and GET are not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users can't sign in and their data capture settings are turned off.

roles.how: IdP groups map to Gong 'assignments' that set Gong seats, permission profile per workspace, data capture and consent profile.

limitations.text: Users whose primary email domain differs from the company's primary domain are not imported.
Provisioned fields (first name, last name, manager, emails, title) can't be edited manually in Gong.

capabilities.notes: No user create/update/deactivate endpoints in the public API reference; user lifecycle is via SCIM. assign_roles = create/update permission profiles.

endpoints.purpose: List users attached to a permission profile
Retrieve logs data by type and time range (e.g. AccessLog, UserActivityLog)

rate_limits.text: 3 API calls per second and 10,000 API calls per day; HTTP 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

okta.notes: OIN capabilities: SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking.

google.notes: Gong documents no Google Workspace provisioning; Google's catalogue was not checked.

onelogin.notes: From Gong's own OneLogin provisioning guide; OneLogin catalogue page not loaded. Gong also documents OneLogin SAML and OIDC sign-in.
